conviction_note: No company-level number the market has not seen: revenue looks set to land at or a little above a ~$413M bar that the company's own FY guide implies. The two live questions are the adjusted EBITDA ramp needed to hit ~$65M (a negative this name has missed on before) and data bookings, where the new $192.5M BMS/Pathos deal is a positive. Beats on this name have been sold three prints running. An 18.6% short float and a call-side skew hold the downside, so p_up sits at 49 on a 7.5% absolute move. The findings sum to -0.5, close to the scaled -0.15: both measures say near-zero.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue ~$410-414M: Benzinga $413.8M (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/TEM/earnings-forecasts), Earnings Whispers $413.24M (https://www.earningswhispers.com/epsdetails/TEM), Trefis ~$413M (https://www.trefis.com/stock/tem/articles/621015/can-you-still-buy-tempus-ai-stock-today/2026-10-28). The company guide implies the same: FY26 revenue $1.595-1.605B less H1 $730.6M leaves ~$869M for H2 (https://www.biospace.com/press-releases/tempus-reports-second-quarter-2026-results). Non-GAAP EPS bar disputed: -$0.08 to -$0.13 across sources. Q3 adjusted EBITDA consensus could not be sourced, so findings that rest on EBITDA are capped small. FY adj EBITDA guide ~$65M.
positioning_check: Short interest 25.38M shares, 18.57% of float, 3.6 days to cover, record date 2026-10-15, published 2026-10-26, +1.0% vs prior (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/TEM/short-interest/). Aug 2026: 18.42% per equibles. Baseline skew_25d -7.03 vol points (calls bid, 'upside paid'), put/call OI 0.44, event-implied move 6.72%, straddle 12.16% to the 11-06 expiry. The stock is +73.6% over 3 months to Oct 28 (Trefis) but 20% below its 52-week high, with 20d -6.4% and 5d +6.1%. This is a crowded short with call skew, so negatives are shrunk.

findings.finding: The FY26 adjusted EBITDA guide of ~$65M (reaffirmed 2026-07-30) needs ~$60M in H2, because H1 delivered only ~$5.2M (Q1 -$2.8M, Q2 +$8.0M). That means Q3+Q4 must average ~$30M a quarter against an $8M Q2. Last year the company guided Q4 2025 adj EBITDA to ~$20M and FY25 to 'slightly positive', then delivered $12.9M and -$7.4M, and the stock fell 7.3% on that print. A Q3 EBITDA well short of the ~$25-30M run-rate, or a trim to the $65M guide, is the clearest negative path.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-02-24 print (Q4 2025 EBITDA $12.9M vs ~$20M guided; FY25 -$7.4M vs 'slightly positive'): -7.32%. 2025-02-24 (weak outlook): -15.05%. Beats on revenue with EBITDA held have moved -0.95% / -1.05% / -2.64%.
findings.why_not_priced: The arithmetic is public, but no Q3 adj-EBITDA consensus is visible on any free aggregator, and previews talk only about revenue (~$413M) and EPS. If the market were pricing a guide-cut risk, the skew would lean to puts. Instead it is -7 (calls bid) and the stock is +74% in 3 months.
findings.independence: Q3 2025 guide vs FY25 delivery: https://www.barchart.com/story/news/35900449/tempus-reports-third-quarter-2025-results and https://www.biospace.com/press-releases/tempus-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results. Counterweight: on the Q1 call the CFO said the back half is 'a bigger period for data', which supports margins (https://finance.yahoo.com/sectors/healthcare/articles/tempus-ai-q1-earnings-call-030911240.html). Shrunk for the crowded short and the unsourced EBITDA bar.

findings.finding: On 2026-10-14 and 10-22 Tempus signed agreements worth $192.5M over ~5 years with BMS and Pathos, disclosed in an 8-K on 10-23. They are $137.5M in fixed quarterly payments for an oncology SOW running to 2031, plus up to $55M for 500k neurology records at $100 each. This follows ~$200M of Q2 bookings. The call will likely cite it as Q4 bookings momentum and data visibility into 2027. The neurology piece is a related-party deal with Pathos (shared leadership and ownership), approved by a special committee.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Data-deal news has moved the stock before: the April 2025 AZ/Pathos $200M deal day was +14.3% (itiger). On prints, Insights growth of 36-44% has not stopped beats being sold (-0.95%, -1.05%).
findings.why_not_priced: The deal is public and probably part of the +6.1% 5-day run-up, so it is largely priced. What is not priced is how management frames it: whether Q3 bookings plus BMS lift total remaining contract value (TCV, never disclosed in the releases) or support 2027 data growth near 30%. If that were in the price, consensus FY26 revenue would already sit above the guide midpoint, and it sits at $1.60B.
findings.independence: Q2 call: ~$200M Q2 bookings, Insights +36% (https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-7-30-tempus-ai-inc-stock/). The same 8-K documents the related-party Pathos structure, which tempers the quality read.

findings.finding: Reaction function: the last three prints beat revenue and raised the FY revenue guide each time (to $1.59-1.60B, then $1.595-1.605B), and the stock moved -1.05% (2026-05-05), -0.95% (2026-07-30) and -2.64% (2025-11-04). Q3 consensus of ~$413M already equals the guide-implied H2 split, so another ~$5M nudge to the guide is the base case and has not been paid for.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Small beat-and-raise: -1.05%, -0.95%, -2.64%. Q2 2026 drifted +4.0% over two days per Trefis.
findings.why_not_priced: The +74% three-month run means expectations are higher than at the last three prints. A routine beat-and-small-raise into that has historically not lifted the stock, while the call skew implies the options market is paying for upside.
findings.independence: Sealed baseline history; guidance steps from the Q1 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001717115/000119312526206317/tem-ex99_1.htm) and the Q2 release. Shrunk because 18.6% short float is a squeeze mechanism on any clean beat.

findings.finding: Hereditary (Ambry) revenue grew only 5% to $107.4M in Q2, about 28% of revenue. Management said it would reach 'mid-teens growth by the end of the year', and Q3 is the first check on that claim. Oncology volume accelerated to +31% (from +28%) and Data and Applications grew +28%, so the other ~72% of revenue would have to slow sharply for hereditary to decide the print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 hereditary +5% printed with the stock -0.95% on the day.
findings.why_not_priced: Weak hereditary growth is known. Whether it re-accelerates is unknown, and peer evidence is mixed: Myriad's Q2 cancer-care volume was +6% and it cited payer friction. Sized net of the rest of the company, so it stays near 0.
findings.independence: Myriad Q2 2026 commentary via search summary (https://myriad.gcs-web.com/static-files/bf421610-48b6-45ab-a9c6-6e6c4bb795b1). This is a proxy, not a Tempus number.

findings.finding: Tempus moved its Q3 release earlier: Monday 2026-11-02 before the open, with the call at 08:45 ET (announced 2026-10-15). Last year's Q3 came Tuesday 2025-11-04 after the close, and the last three prints were all after the close.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The only recent bmo prints were 2026-01-12 (a JPM-week pre-announcement, +4.51%) and 2025-08-08 (+3.63%), both up.
findings.why_not_priced: Timing signals are weak and rarely priced. An earlier, pre-open slot is loosely associated with a clean quarter. Two aggregators still list Nov 9, so parts of the market have the date wrong.
findings.independence: Sealed baseline history shows the two bmo prints were both positive. This is inference, not a document.
